capabilities: post tweets and threads to X from a composer or commands
auto-split long text into 280-character thread posts
attach or embed vault images in posts
manage multiple named X accounts with encrypted credentials
extras: Image uploads work on desktop only; detailed setup and troubleshooting guide covers common X API errors (403 client-not-enrolled, read-only tokens, usage caps, 401 authentication).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to post a note or selection to X, so users must leave the app and manually split long text into threads.

requires.name: X API keys and access tokens
paid X plan for tweets over 280 characters

summary: X (Twitter) posting plugin that publishes single tweets and threads from notes via a composer, quick-post commands, auto-splitting, images, and multiple accounts.
